address: 109 Charoen Rajd Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50000, Thailand
bio: For decades, this place has been serving distinctive Khao Kriab Pak Moh, or steamed rice skin dumplings, opposite Wat Ket Karam. These contain a tasty salty-sweet filling wrapped in a coconut-infused rice flour sheet and a side of coconut cream. Tapioca balls with sweet pork are also offered....
